title: Sustainable zeolite/activated carbon nanocomposite for dual-dye adsorption, kinetic and thermodynamic studies, and urea electro-oxidation applications
content:

DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06559C, Paper

Abdullah S. Alawam, Samar M. Mahgoub, Ahmed A. Allam, Abdelatty M. Radalla, Marwa H. Shemy, Rehab Mahmoud
This study developed a novel zeolite/activated carbon nanocomposite (Zeo/AC) for the simultaneous removal of carcinogenic Congo Red (CR) and Crystal Violet (CV) dyes, with subsequent energy recovery.
